description: Lithuanian employment salary (darbo užmokestis pagal darbo sutartį): from gross (bruto, "ant popieriaus") to net (į rankas) or from net to gross, with income tax (GPM), the tax-free amount (NPD), employee and employer Sodra contributions (VSD, PSD) and the total cost to the employer (darbo vietos kaina). Use for "kiek į rankas nuo bruto", "kiek kainuoja darbuotojas", "alga ant popieriaus". Not for payouts to a member of a small partnership (MB narys). Row ids: bruto (gross), npd (tax-free amount applied), gpm (income tax), pensija, liga, motinyste, psd, kaupimas (employee contributions), darbuotojo-imokos (employee contributions total), i-rankas (net pay), nedarbas, nelaimingi, garantinis, ilgalaikis (employer contributions), darbdavio-imokos (employer contributions total), grindys-darbuotojo and grindys-darbdavio (minimum-contribution top-up, only below the minimum wage), darbo-vietos-kaina (total employer cost).

additional_pension.description: true when the employee pays the additional pension accumulation contribution (papildomas pensijų kaupimas). Omitted: false.

amount.description: Monthly salary: gross or net, as `direction` says. In euros, at most 2 decimal places.

contract.description: Employment contract type: open_ended (neterminuota) or fixed_term (terminuota). It changes the employer's unemployment insurance rate. Omitted: open_ended.

direction.description: "gross": amount is the gross salary (bruto), compute net. "net": amount is the net pay (į rankas), compute gross.

minimum_floor_waived.description: true when the minimum-contribution floor (Sodros įmokų „grindys“) does not apply this month. The site lists the cases: another job, a pension, age under 24, 0–55 percent work capacity, or a maternity, paternity or childcare benefit. It matters only below the minimum monthly wage (MMA). Omitted: false.

year.description: Tax year (metai): 2026 or 2027. Omit it to use the current year in Vilnius time, as the site's calculators do.

name: calculate_salary

apiUrl.description: The same calculation as JSON over plain HTTP GET.

calculatorInput.description: The same input as the site calculator read it, defaults filled in (Lithuanian field names).

checkedAt.description: Date the figures were last checked against the sources, YYYY-MM-DD.

message.description: Conditions and assumptions the site shows with the result (Lithuanian).

preliminary.description: Rate fields that come from a draft, not from an adopted act. Empty when all are adopted.

rows.description: Result lines, in the order the site shows them.

cents.description: Amount in integer euro cents. For the line with id "dienos" it is a number of days.

label.description: Label as shown on the site (Lithuanian).

value.description: Formatted value as shown on the site.

sources.description: Primary sources (VMI, Sodra, legal acts) behind the figures.

taxYear.description: Tax year of the rates used.

url.description: The buhalteris.ai calculator page showing this same calculation.

warning.description: Shown when a rule could not be applied reliably. Empty otherwise.

yearNote.description: The note the site shows under the year choice (Lithuanian): which rates apply and which are still preliminary.

title: Salary calculator (atlyginimo skaičiuoklė)
